title: MSRR plant deck
description: Top-level plant identity plus included sections. Authoring files live under data/plants/<id>/ as YAML; this schema documents the merged object. Enforced at load time by helpers.plant_config.validate_plant via helpers.data_validation (errors name the file and dotted path).

nominal_power.description: PowerBlock P [W]. Must carry doc and source.

total_fuel_vol.description: Total primary salt inventory [m3]. Must carry doc and source.

source_scale.description: LEGACY lumped external-source normalizer (inlined 1.58e20 in the lumped mPKE; not a physical population).

nu.description: Mean neutrons per fission [1]; SegmentedMSR derives the full-power population N0 = LAMBDA*nu*P/E_f and the poison-worth denominator Sigma_a = nu*Sigma_f from it.

source_effectiveness.description: External-source effectiveness eta_S [1] (source importance relative to the fundamental mode); normalized source rate = eta_S*S/N0. Default 1.0 is an unsourced unit-importance assumption.

lumped_tau_core.description: Named convention, not derived from 9R volumes [s].

lumped_tau_loop.description: Named convention, not derived from 9R volumes [s].

kinetics.description: Shared delayed-neutron data. Every quantity must carry doc and source.

nom_frac.description: Rounded literal on purpose, not derived from DHYG/DHlamG [1].

decay_heat.description: Three-group ANS-94 decay heat. Every quantity must carry doc and source.

k.description: Conductivity; zero is allowed (conduction off) for fuel/graphite/coolant/hx_tube. The optional radial-stack records channel_pipe and annular_fluid additionally REQUIRE k and must be strictly positive in rho/cp/k (TASK-20260914-01 P1).

materials.description: Constant material properties. Every quantity must carry doc and source. channel_pipe and annular_fluid are the optional shared records backing the intra-channel radial stack; they are required only by enabled radial cores.

volumes.description: Named volumes in connect order; each a quantity in m3.

pipes.description: Each pipe carries volFracNode, Ac, L, Ar, e, Tinf, T_0 (temperatures in degC).
Each pipe carries vol, volFracNode, Ac, L, Ar, e, Tinf, T_0.

secondary_loop.description: HX, UHX, secondary pipes. Demand schedules are scenario data.

pumps.description: Hardware defaults. Ramp schedules belong in scenario YAML.

poisons.description: Homogeneous Te-I-Xe / Pm-Sm poison data. No topology-sized arrays. Every physical quantity must carry doc and source.

yield_convention.description: independent = every yield is an independent (direct) yield; chain_entry = members with a modeled parent carry independent yields, and a chain's first modeled member may carry the cumulative yield of its unmodeled precursors (per isotope in yield_basis).

yield_basis.description: Per-isotope yield basis; required when yield_convention is chain_entry. cumulative_chain_entry is allowed only on a chain's first modeled member (Te135, Pm149).

maturity.description: Machine-readable poison-data maturity label (owner-settable enum; validated at load time by helpers.plant_config): reference = data that passed the owner's scientific review of pedigree, spectrum, and the reduced-order worth coefficient; reduced_order_pending_review = reduced-order first-cut data, not approved for production or publication use.

cores.description: Discretization fork. Keys r1 and r9 map to CLI --core_model 1r/9r; the optional r1_10seg and r5x5_z10 sections map to --core_model 1r10seg / r5x5_z10. Every core may carry the optional intra_channel_radial block ($defs/intraChannelRadial; TASK-20260914-01 P1).

outer_fuel_annulus.description: Optional plant-level outer-core fuel annulus / reactor-vessel / fixed-cavity dataset (TASK-20260917-01 P7; plan §7), authored in shared/core_vessel.yaml and included under this pinned key. Absent block = disabled defaults (nothing is emitted). Shipped state is enabled: false with production_enablement.status: blocked (the P1 decision record).

harness.description: QA-collapse parity literals. Documentation-only; not emitted into product PlantData.

outerAnnulusUnsupported.description: The valueless disabled-deck placeholder (the P1 'status: unsupported' convention): a mapping with no 'value' key, carrying 'status: unsupported' plus the declared-unit documentation. Permitted placeholder on a disabled deck; helpers.plant_config refuses it fail-closed on any enabled deck (an enabled configuration must carry the sourced quantity).

outerAnnulusQuantity.description: A sourced physical quantity of the outer fuel annulus: the {value, unit} quantity envelope (doc/source provenance per quantity.schema.json), OR - on a DISABLED deck only - the valueless 'status: unsupported' placeholder. Bare numbers are NOT part of this contract: the loader reads every such leaf as a quantity mapping and refuses a non-quantity shape ('must be a quantity {value, unit}').

outerFuelAnnulus.description: Optional outer-core fuel annulus / reactor-vessel / fixed-cavity dataset (TASK-20260917-01 P7; plan §7.1/§7.2). One plant-level block in shared/core_vessel.yaml, a sibling dataset of the intra-channel radial stack with a separate identity: separate key, separate generated packages (SegmentedMSR_PlantData.OuterFuelAnnulus*), separate fingerprints, no shared names/keys/commands/fingerprints with the radial stack or its dedicated loop. Validation (helpers.plant_config._validate_outer_fuel_annulus) is fail-closed, every refusal naming the configuration path and the offending value. Shipped deck: enabled false, production_enablement.status blocked (P1 decision record; valueless status: unsupported nodes are the permitted placeholders HERE and are refused on any enabled deck). Structural codes (plan §6.1): topology.series_location_code in {1 disabled, 2 core-then-annulus, 3 annulus-then-core} (disabled decks record 1; enabled decks record 2 or 3), topology.flow_direction_code in {1 = segment 1->nSeg, 2 = nSeg->1}. Interfaces (plan §7.1): interfaces.graphite_to_fuel.mode in {authored_matrix (code 0 - the authored G_modAnn matrix IS the conductance, the P1 mapping policy), film (code 1 - requires h > 0)}; interfaces.fuel_to_vessel.mode in {perfect (code 0), film (code 1)}. Cavity: cavity.enabled (default false = adiabatic vessel exterior), cavity.mode in {ua (code 1), radiation (code 2), ua_and_radiation (code 3)} with mode-consistent per-segment vessel_UA/vessel_area/vessel_effective_emissivity arrays (zero/absent parameters for disabled modes where ambiguity would otherwise result), cavity.temperature authored in degC (the emitter converts to kelvin; positive after conversion), and cavity.loop_surfaces naming known external primary-loop surfaces only (SegmentedMSR.Core.CavityLoopSurface: pipeCoreToDHRS, dhrs, pipeDHRStoHX, pipeHXtoCore, heatExchanger; no duplicates, no secondary surfaces). Inventory (plan §4.10): inventory_policy exactly one of {split_existing, revise_total}; split_existing requires inventory.legacy_term = the target core's cell_vol sum, inventory.total_retained = the plant total_fuel_vol, and the annulus volume carved out of the legacy term (never added on top - no double counting). First production target: first_production_target names the core the dataset is authored for and keys the generated package (OuterFuelAnnulus<CoreTag>); an ENABLED r9 target refuses fail-closed (plan §3.1: no physical zone-to-outer-boundary mapping; card A12); r1/r1_10seg/r5x5_z10 are supported. Geometry (plan §7.1): geometry.graphite_outer_radius < geometry.vessel_inner_radius < geometry.vessel_outer_radius (all > 0, m), geometry.physical_length one entry per target-core axial segment (m, > 0, matched against the core's channel_geom LF chain under strict_physical), geometry.annulus_volume authored only under effective_thermal. Provenance: every sourced quantity on an enabled deck carries doc + source.

enabled.description: Feature flag; the executable structural switch is topology.series_location_code (code 1 = disabled).

dataset_id.description: Dataset identity; required (non-empty) when enabled. Mirrored into the disabled generated record.

maturity.description: Dataset maturity label (CORE_MATURITY_VALUES); required when enabled.

geometry_policy.description: Plan §3.4 (same two meanings as the radial stack, separate field/identity). Default strict_physical.

volume_tolerance.description: Relative tolerance of the strict-physical closure checks [1]; enabled-path only, refused under effective_thermal.

production_enablement.description: Governance record (P1 decision record). status: blocked | enabled; an enabled: true deck cannot carry status: blocked.

inventory_policy.description: Plan §4.10; exactly one recorded policy. Required when enabled.

first_production_target.description: Core the dataset is authored for; keys the generated OuterFuelAnnulus<CoreTag> package. Required.

geometry.description: Enabled-path only (refused on a disabled deck). Radii strictly ordered; physical_length one entry per target-core axial segment; annulus_volume authored only under effective_thermal (the cylindrical law is authoritative under strict_physical).

physical_length.description: Per-segment annulus/vessel physical length L_j [m], one entry per core axial segment (never L/nSeg).

annulus_volume.description: Authored per-segment annulus volume [m3]. P0: under effective_thermal this IS the executable cell storage volume (required positive on an enabled deck; the thermal cells' mass/heat capacity consume it); refused under strict_physical (the cylindrical law is authoritative there). Geometry (radii/lengths) still defines the heat-transfer areas/resistance; a storage-vs-geometry mismatch is disclosed, never silent.

moderator_coupling.description: Authored G_modAnn boundary conductances (plan §4.2: never inferred from the ChannelMap neighbor table). mapping_policy: authored_matrix is the only supported value.

conductance.description: G_modAnn[nChan][nSeg] [W/K], entries >= 0, at least one > 0 on an enabled deck with the authored_matrix interface mode.

interfaces.description: Radial interface parameterizations; required when enabled. graphite_to_fuel.mode: authored_matrix (code 0; requires the G_modAnn matrix, refuses a film coefficient) or film (code 1; requires h > 0, refuses a sourced matrix). fuel_to_vessel.mode: perfect (code 0; refuses h) or film (code 1; requires h > 0).

vessel_material.description: Reactor-vessel steel (sourced identity, e.g. SS316H, plus sourced rho/cp/k on an enabled deck).

fuel_conductivity.description: REV-21c79f7-01 (TASK-20260918-01): annulus radial conductivity of the PRIMARY FUEL [W/(m.K)] - a separate datum from the generated Materials.kFuel placeholder (0 = axial salt conduction off, PLAN23-08). Required strictly positive (sourced) on an enabled deck: the annulus cells' radial resistance consumes it, so missing/zero/placeholder values refuse fail-closed naming the path. The shipped disabled deck records the valueless status: unsupported placeholder; sourced values on a disabled deck are validated but inert (the disabled record emits kFuel = 0, never consumed).

cavity.description: Ideal fixed-temperature cavity boundary (plan §4.5/§4.6, §5.7, §9.2). cavity.enabled=false = adiabatic vessel exterior (sourced cavity data refused as phantom data).

enabled.description: Default false (adiabatic). Requires the outer_fuel_annulus enabled.

temperature.description: Fixed cavity setpoint [degC, the plant convention; the emitter converts to kelvin and it must be positive after conversion]. Required when cavity.enabled.

mode.description: Vessel-to-cavity transfer mode (codes 1/2/3); required when cavity.enabled.

vessel_UA.description: Per-segment effective linear conductance [W/K]; required for modes ua/ua_and_radiation, refused (ambiguity) for mode radiation.

vessel_area.description: Per-segment external vessel area [m2]; required for radiation modes, refused for mode ua.

vessel_effective_emissivity.description: Per-segment effective emissivity [1] within [0, 1]; required (with at least one positive entry) for radiation modes.

loop_surfaces.description: Cavity-exposed external primary-loop surfaces (plan §9.2); no duplicates; secondary surfaces are not in the dictionary.

precursor_importance.description: Annulus delayed-neutron importance (plan §4.8). weights absent = the documented zero-credit policy; present weights are a per-segment nonnegative array [1].

weights.description: w[a,j] [1], one entry per segment, each >= 0.

initialization.description: Declared initial annulus/vessel temperatures [degC, the plant convention; the emitter converts to kelvin]. Scalars (the generated record binds one per medium). Required when enabled.

fission.description: Annulus fission (plan §5.1/§5.2; TASK-20260918-01 P1): the conservative SPLIT of the existing total fission source, never an additive source. Absent block = fission disabled with zero fraction vectors and the first-release policies. enabled=true requires the outer_fuel_annulus enabled AND explicitly authored distributions + policies with complete provenance; enabled=false requires every fraction entry 0. Validation (fail-closed, no silent renormalization): finite, nonnegative entries; length = the target core's n_seg; the STRICT retained-share rule 1-fsum(f) >= 1e-9 on BOTH vectors (hence 0 <= sum_j f_a,j < 1; the active core keeps F_c = 1 - F_a > 0 with at least a 1e-9 share); elementwise f^S = f^Q under local_same_fraction within OUTER_ANNULUS_FISSION_FRACTION_TOLERANCE (1e-9); unsupported policy names refuse. source_fraction and heat_deposition_fraction stay DISTINCT names (fission-event location and energy deposition are not generally the same physical quantity; the equality under local_same_fraction is a validation rule, not a schema collapse).

enabled.description: Default false. Requires the outer_fuel_annulus enabled; false requires every fraction entry 0.

coupling_policy.description: Plan §5.1; local_same_fraction is the ONLY first-release coupling policy (elementwise f^S = f^Q enforced); a second policy is a future owner decision. Required explicitly on a fission-enabled deck.

source_fraction.description: f^S_a[j] [1]: fraction of whole-reactor fission EVENTS occurring in annulus segment j; one entry per target-core axial segment; strict retained-share 1-fsum(f) >= 1e-9 (hence 0 <= sum < 1); provenance required when sourced (doc+source on any fission-enabled deck).

heat_deposition_fraction.description: f^Q_a[j] [1]: fraction of whole-reactor prompt fission POWER deposited in annulus segment j (the P2 splitter delivers f^Q_a[j]*P_total to annulus cell j and (1-F_a^Q)*P_total to the core); same rules as source_fraction; elementwise equal to it under local_same_fraction.

annulus_temperature_feedback_policy.description: Plan §5.6; zero_credit is the ONLY first-release policy (explicit, fingerprinted, manifest-visible no-credit); weighted policies are a future owner decision. Required explicitly on a fission-enabled deck.

poison_flux_exposure_policy.description: Plan §5.5; zero_credit is the ONLY first-release policy (whole-reactor poison production, no annulus absorption exposure credit); weighted policies are a future owner decision. Required explicitly on a fission-enabled deck.

annulus_temperature_feedback.description: Weighted temperature-feedback placeholders (plan §5.6): UNSUPPORTED in the first release - valueless 'status: unsupported' nodes only; sourced values refuse fail-closed under the zero_credit policy.

weights.description: w^T_a[j] [1] placeholders; declared unit when sourced: 1. Sourced values refuse in the first release.

coefficient_alpha.description: alpha_f,a placeholder; declared unit when sourced: 1/K. Sourced values refuse in the first release.

poison_flux_exposure.description: Weighted poison-exposure placeholders (plan §5.5): UNSUPPORTED in the first release - valueless 'status: unsupported' nodes only; sourced values refuse fail-closed under the zero_credit policy.

weights.description: w^phi_a[j] [1] placeholders; declared unit when sourced: 1. Sourced values refuse in the first release.

inventory.description: The P1 inventory-decision record (plan §4.10). split_existing: legacy_term = the target core's cell_vol sum (the in-vessel term the annulus is carved from), subtraction.expression records the carve, total_retained = the plant total_fuel_vol (preserved); active_core_cell_volume (P0) is the EXECUTABLE carved [n_chan][n_seg] matrix the embedded core and precursor network consume - positive entries, whole-volume closure sum(V_active) + sum(V_annulus) + V_loop = total_retained within 1e-6, and (one-channel target) per-elevation closure V_active,j + V_annulus,j = V_legacy,j with positive remainders; revise_total requires inventory.total_revised and the sourced geometry for the closure check.

legacy_term.description: [m3]; must equal the target core's cell_vol sum within 1e-9.

total_retained.description: [m3]; must equal plant total_fuel_vol within 1e-9 and legacy_term + external-loop volume within 1e-6.

total_revised.description: [m3]; must equal cell_vol + annulus + external-loop volume within 1e-6 (revise_total only).

active_core_cell_volume.description: P0: the executable carved active-core channel fuel volume matrix [n_chan][n_seg] [m3] consumed by the embedded SegmentedCore / PrecursorNetwork ChannelMap (required on an enabled split_existing deck; whole-volume and one-channel per-elevation closure enforced).

axial_grid_1r10seg.description: Decision-record elevations section for the r1_10seg target (P1). When authored for the first production target, n_seg must match the core's n_seg and lf_per_segment x n_seg must match the core's channel_geom LF sum within 1e-9.

then.description: Enabled path: every quantity leaf must carry the sourced {value, unit} envelope - the valueless 'status: unsupported' placeholder is refused fail-closed (helpers.plant_config: an enabled configuration must carry sourced data before it reaches Modelica), and a film coefficient 'h' must not accompany the enabled-deck interface modes (authored_matrix/perfect; the film modes themselves are refused on an enabled deck).

mode.description: graphite_to_fuel: authored_matrix | film; fuel_to_vessel: perfect | film. P0: the film modes are UNSUPPORTED on an enabled deck (no film interface is implemented in the Modelica assembly; film is a documented future extension) - enabled decks declare authored_matrix / perfect; the shipped disabled deck keeps its film placeholder.

h.description: Film coefficient [W/(m2.K)], > 0; required exactly for the film modes and refused with authored_matrix/perfect.

numRampUp.description: Integer >= 1; rampUpK/rampUpTo/rampUpTime lengths must equal it.

intraChannelRadial.description: Optional per-core intra-channel radial stack configuration (TASK-20260914-01 P1; plan §2.2, §6). Absent block = disabled default. Valid combinations only: disabled (mode N/A, no heat exchanger); enabled+static (no heat exchanger, no loop data); enabled+circulating; enabled+circulating+heat exchanger. annular_loop.heat_exchanger.enabled=true is refused unless the stack is enabled AND annular_fluid.mode=circulating. Every physics quantity is a quantity envelope with doc+source (plan §13.17). Mode/enum fields: annular_fluid.mode in {static, circulating}; annular_fluid.flow_direction in {bottom_to_top, top_to_bottom}; geometry_policy in {strict_physical, effective_thermal}; channel_meaning in {literal_tube, aggregate_bundle}; interfaces.<name>.mode in {perfect, film}. channel_meaning='literal_tube' holds exactly when channel_multiplicity = 1, and 'aggregate_bundle' requires channel_multiplicity >= 2. Annular-loop channel_flow_fractions has one entry per annular loop channel (n_chan for r1/r1_10seg/r5x5_z10; n_zones for the four-zone segmented 9R core), each >= 0, summing to 1 within 1e-6 (SegmentedMSR.Core.fracTol).

enabled.description: Structural decision 1: does the intra-channel radial stack exist? Default false; the disabled direct fuel-to-moderator path stays structurally and numerically unchanged (plan §2.1).

maturity.description: Radial dataset maturity (CORE_MATURITY_VALUES); required (non-empty) when enabled.

dataset_id.description: Radial dataset identity; required when enabled.

geometry_policy.description: Plan §2.4; review rev019 Phase 2 (TASK-20260915-01 P2). strict_physical (default) requires: (1) fuel-volume closure per stack cell, N_c*pi*fuel_radius^2*physical_length[j] = declared salt inventory within volume_tolerance; (2) the stated per-segment physical length to match the core's authored fuel length (channel_geom LF chain) - the stack length is never map.dz unless proven equal for the core; (3) lattice packing, 2*annulus_outer_radius <= pitch and pairwise annulus non-overlap; (4) material-volume closure, pi*annulus_outer_radius^2 <= lattice cell area. effective_thermal permits a reported discrepancy. volume_tolerance applies only under strict_physical.

channel_meaning.description: What ONE modeled coarse thermal channel represents (review rev019 Phase 2; TASK-20260915-01 P2): literal_tube (default) = exactly one physical fuel tube per modeled coarse channel (channel_multiplicity = 1); aggregate_bundle = a bundle of channel_multiplicity identical parallel physical tubes per modeled coarse channel.

channel_multiplicity.description: Physical-channel multiplicity N_c [1]: identical parallel physical fuel tubes per modeled coarse thermal channel; integer >= 1, default 1. Scales the radial chain (R_equiv = R_single/N_c) and the per-cell pipe/annular volumes and capacities (C_equiv = N_c*C_single) through the bundle-equivalent length N_c*L_j; the annular-loop mass flow, plenum and connecting-pipe volumes, and the heat-exchanger conductance and loop-side volume are authored as WHOLE-BUNDLE totals and are NOT scaled. Direct-deposition fractions are shares of fission power and are not scaled.

volume_tolerance.description: Relative tolerance of the strict_physical geometry-closure checks [1]; default 1e-6.

geometry.description: Shared concentric radii [m], strictly ordered 0 < fuel_radius < pipe_outer_radius < annulus_outer_radius, plus the explicit per-segment physical radial length [m] (one entry per core axial segment: n_seg for r1/r1_10seg/r5x5_z10; the summed n_seg_zone for the segmented 9R core). Present only when enabled.

physical_length.description: Per-segment physical radial (fuel) length L_j [m]; all entries > 0; required when enabled. Distinct from the channel_map axial pitch dz (moderator center spacing) unless proven equal for that core (1r10seg: LF = 0.1575 m vs dz = 0.14 m).

annular_fluid.description: Structural decision 2. mode default static; circulating requires enabled=true.

flow_direction.description: Shared structural direction for all annular loop channels; default bottom_to_top.

annular_loop.description: Annular-loop data; present only when enabled AND mode=circulating (plan §10.12: static mode carries no loop data). channel_flow_fractions length must equal the annular loop channel count; plenum volumes strictly positive; connecting_pipe_volume >= 0 (0 = M_pipes=0 explicit, plan §2.4). All loop volumes and the heat-exchanger data are WHOLE-BUNDLE totals (the loop serves the bundle as a whole; not scaled by channel_multiplicity).

nominal_mass_flow.description: Prescribed total annular-loop mass flow for the WHOLE bundle [kg/s], > 0 (per-tube flow is nominal_mass_flow/N_c implicitly; residence times stay correct).

max_flow_command.description: Maximum allowed flow command u [1], >= 1 so u=1 nominal stays inside the bound.

channel_flow_fractions.description: One fraction per annular loop channel [1]; each >= 0; sum = 1 within 1e-6.

supply_plenum_volume.description: Explicit declared supply plenum volume [m3], > 0 (whole-bundle total).

return_plenum_volume.description: Explicit declared return plenum volume [m3], > 0 (whole-bundle total).

connecting_pipe_volume.description: Declared connecting-pipe loop inventory [m3], >= 0 (0 = not dynamically modeled, documented omission).

heat_exchanger.description: Structural decision 3: the dedicated annular-loop heat exchanger. enabled=true requires the stack enabled AND circulating (plan §2.2); then model/ua/loop_side_volume/sink_temperature/initial_temperature are all required. ua and loop_side_volume are WHOLE-BUNDLE totals (not scaled by channel_multiplicity).

model.description: Heat-exchanger model identity, not a selector: finite_conductance_prescribed_sink while enabled, none while disabled (absent canonicalizes to none); any other value is refused by the loader.

interfaces.description: Radial interface parameters; present only when enabled. Perfect contact is an explicit mode selection, never an arbitrarily large coefficient (plan §6.5).

heat_deposition.description: Optional direct-deposition shares into the radial materials (plan §6.7, §14). Defaults pipe_fraction = annular_fluid_fraction = 0; the fuel/moderator shares stay the established per-core q_fiss/q_mod split; all shares must sum to 1 within 1e-9.

pipe_fraction.description: Direct share to the pipe wall [1], within [0, 1]; default 0.

annular_fluid_fraction.description: Direct share to the annular fluid [1], within [0, 1]; default 0.

h.description: Film coefficient [W/(m2.K)], > 0; required exactly when mode = film and refused with mode = perfect.

n_chan.description: Must be 1; flow_frac/channel_map.chanR/channel_map.xy lengths must equal it.

n_seg.description: Must be 2; cell_vol/q_fiss/q_mod/kHT/IF/channel_geom.LF/channel_geom.ArF lengths must equal it.

channel_map.description: Coarse lattice metadata for the later SegmentedMSR bind (pitch_type, pitch, dz, chanR, xy). This schema twin documents only the lattice-geometry declaration (TASK-20260916-01 P4); the remaining lattice fields are loader-validated and are placeholder capacity values that do not control heat capacity (cell_vol and vol_graphite set the inventories).

lattice_geometry.description: Lattice-geometry provenance declaration (review rev020 Phase 4 option 2; TASK-20260916-01 P4): what the coarse channel_map lattice metadata (pitch and the derived cell area) represents. 'physical' = the deck authors a real tube lattice whose geometry is physical closure data; geometry_policy 'strict_physical' requires it. 'placeholder' (the default; an ABSENT declaration canonicalizes to it) = the pitch/cell area are placeholder capacity values, so 'strict_physical' is refused for them and 'effective_thermal' is the honest policy. Validated at load time by helpers.plant_config (RADIAL_LATTICE_GEOMETRY_VALUES / RADIAL_LATTICE_GEOMETRY_DEFAULT).

maturity.description: Machine-readable implementation-maturity label (owner-settable enum; validated at load time by helpers.plant_config): reference_regression = legacy computational reference for regression and parity checks (not a physically validated dataset); discretization_study = uniform first-cut partition, no independent spatial-profile validation; exploratory_geometry = placeholder lattice, surrogate graphite grade.

physical_data_maturity.description: Machine-readable physical-data maturity label (owner-settable enum; validated at load time by helpers.plant_config): reviewed_design_basis = traced to a reviewed external design basis; legacy_inherited = inherited from the former Modelica implementation, not yet source-reviewed; pending_source_review = source named, review open; synthetic = placeholder values without physical provenance.

n_regions.description: Must be 9; vol_F1..ArF2 and trim.*_regions lengths must equal it.

n_zones.description: Must be 4; flow_frac_zones/Ac_zones/region_trip_time/zone_start/zone_end/n_seg_zone lengths must equal it.

flow_frac_zones.description: Zone flow fractions; each positive, sum = 1.

graphite_split_policy.description: Graphite-direct share is the raw sum(kHT1+kHT2); do not renormalize.

vol_upper_plenum.description: Symbolic rule node (no value/unit); e.g. '2 * vdot_fuel'.

maturity.description: Machine-readable core-maturity label (owner-settable enum; validated at load time by helpers.plant_config).

physical_data_maturity.description: Machine-readable physical-data maturity label (owner-settable enum; validated at load time by helpers.plant_config): reviewed_design_basis = traced to a reviewed external design basis; legacy_inherited = inherited from the former Modelica implementation, not yet source-reviewed; pending_source_review = source named, review open; synthetic = placeholder values without physical provenance.
